build_resnetv2_model: build a ResNetV2 Haiku module with configurable depth, num_classes, width_mult, and rematerialization
create_bottleneck_block: create a BottleneckBlock residual block with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv layers for ResNet50/101 architectures
create_basic_block: create a BasicBlock residual block with 1x1-3x3 conv layers for ResNet18/34 architectures
build_resnet_unit: build a ResNetUnit grouping multiple residual blocks with optional gradient checkpointing via remat
run_resnetv2_forward: run a ResNetV2 forward pass returning intermediate activations at any valid endpoint
